title: Census of small gadgets for the harmony
claim: Census of all gadgets with at most five triangles (1, 0, 30, 1293, 73326 up to isomorphism; linear 1, 0, 8, 48, 2520). Standing wave w_q = K + q M: exact for generic q on 1, 14, 172, 5694 gadgets (n = 1, 3, 4, 5); by locking 1, 14, 92, 3078 and by balanced cancellation 0, 0, 80, 2616 (no algebraic cancellation up to five triangles). Signed not-all-equal (q = 0) is exact on 1, 14, 206, 8584: 3082 of them at the knot angle only (584 by locking at pi/3), while 192 generic gadgets lose it (lambda(0) = 0); on linear gadgets with n <= 5 the knot's gadgets are exactly the generic ones (6, 4, 520). The 14 exact 3-triangle gadgets all have lambda = q^2 - 1 and corner growth 2; the Sierpinski gadget is one of the 6 linear ones. Special parameters: besides the knot, the quarter wave q = 1 (pi/4, exact on 6846 at n = 5), q = 2 (pi/6, 7170), the non-crystallographic real angle cos 2 theta = -1/3 (q = 1/3, 680 only there) and complex values; at n = 5 the knot angle is exact on the most gadgets among the non-degenerate real angles (8584), the degenerate limit q = 3 on more (9494). The cosine wave has the same generic gadgets as the standing wave at n = 3, 5 and none at n = 4; plain not-all-equal is exact on no gadget with 2 <= n <= 5. Corner growth rates of exact towers are certified algebraic integers in [2, n - 1], with exponents log n / log rho in [log 5 / log 4, log 5 / log 2] at n = 5. Beyond five triangles the small-size coincidences end (exact examples): a linear 6-triangle gadget exact at the knot only, a linear 6-triangle generic gadget with lambda(0) = 0, and a linear 7-triangle gadget generic for the standing wave but not for the cosine wave.
failure_conditions: A gadget with at most five triangles missing from, or duplicated in, the census.
A count that does not reproduce, or the two contraction codes disagreeing.
A growth rate whose certificate fails.
An example beyond five triangles that does not reproduce exactly.
foundation_claim_scope: Finite census of gadgets with at most five triangles for three pencils of three-bit laws; corner-chain growth of the substitution towers as a combinatorial count (not a metric).

validation.status: checked: enumeration replayed by an independent enumerator (n <= 4) and random completeness probes (n = 5); every corner relation computed by two independent codes; classifications exact over the integers; growth rates certified by positive min-policy eigenvectors; examples beyond five triangles exact; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: no overlap found (candidate local delta): a census of gluings selected by a fixed signed law; growth via independent-row spectral radius (Rothblum-Whittle, Blondel-Nesterov) is classical
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
